scope: Offline catalog of the seven local research ledgers; no network access and no benchmark run.

special_evidence_boundaries.C01: Attempted access only: the official product page was not treated as a full read; claims were cross-checked against the upstream repository.
special_evidence_boundaries.A13: Abstract-level evidence only; the full paper was not read in this pass.
special_evidence_boundaries.Q08: Abstract and metadata only; no full paper was read in this pass.
special_evidence_boundaries.Q09: Abstract and metadata only; no full paper was read in this pass.
special_evidence_boundaries.M11: Course index and chapter list only; lesson videos were not downloaded or watched.
special_evidence_boundaries.M12: Course index and description only; lesson videos were not downloaded or watched.

limitations: The catalog packages ledger claims; it does not independently re-read or re-verify every source.
Canonical URL deduplication does not prove that two source records used identical text, protocol, or evidence scope; source_refs preserve those records separately.
The practitioner entries classified as anecdotal are useful reports and failure evidence, not representative success-rate measurements.
M11 and M12 describe course indexes/chapters; their lesson videos were not downloaded or watched.
No forward benchmark or generated Blender artifact was run by this script.
interpretation: Snapshot counts and read depths, not independent studies or plugin runtime results. Raw captures and the local investigation are not included.
